snippet.title: Dark Offering - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Dark Offering is an upcoming linear, first-person RPG blended with tactical, card-based combat. Explore a handcrafted world that is filled with loot, puzzles and monstrous creatures.

Credits to Rick Browning for the amazing VO work!

Help us on our journey and wishlist Dark Offering on Steam!
